name: SUMM-RE - French spontaneous meetings (ASR evaluation corpus)
description: Recorded French meetings (3-4 speakers, 20 min each), one close-talk track per speaker with a manual verbatim transcription. Used by WAMA as an ASR evaluation corpus: each meeting is MIXED into one recording (the real use case: a room recording), its reference is the speakers' segments merged in time order. Prepared on demand by `manage.py asr_eval_corpus summ-re` (WAMA_QUALITE 9bis). Oral-corpus marks (`_` word links, `+` pauses, `*`, `@`) are neutralised by the measurement protocol `text_v2`, hesitations are kept (verbatim).

signals.description: One close-talk track per speaker, WAV 48 kHz mono 16 bit
Manual verbatim transcription of a track, timed segments with word timings
DERIVED: the tracks of a meeting resampled to 16 kHz, summed and peak-normalised (media library nature `speech`)
DERIVED: the segments of all tracks merged by start time, SRT with `[Locuteur NNN]` labels (media library nature `document`)
